{"subject":"Quick hello from Sam at Harbor Street","body":"Hi,

I've been following Column from a distance and wanted to say hello. I'd love to hear what you're focused on right now and what's been surprising you lately.

If it's useful, I'm happy to set up a 20-minute call in the next couple of weeks. No agenda beyond catching up and seeing if there's anything I can be helpful with.

Hope the team is doing well.

Sam"}
